from rcb_hb import Session
import numpy as np

INSTANCE = '/app/instance.npz'
OUT = '/app/output/trajectory.npz'

def normalized(s, physical):
    lo, hi = s.model.actuator_ctrlrange.T
    return np.clip(2 * (physical - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)

def main():
    s = Session('bookshelf_simple', instance=INSTANCE)
    target = np.zeros(s.nu)
    for i in range(21):
        j = s.model.actuator_trnid[i, 0]
        target[i] = s.data.qpos[s.model.joint(j).qposadr[0]]
    actions = np.repeat(normalized(s, target)[None, :], 1000, axis=0)
    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={'method': 'initial joint hold baseline'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
